packages.name: serde_with
changes: Remove the unused optional chrono dependency and weak feature propagation; legacy chrono feature names fail explicitly if requested. Std, alloc, macros and other serialization adapters retain upstream code.

Keep upstream source and required license notices. Upstream guide/README text uses .txt filenames to preserve the repository documentation layout; omit registry metadata, upstream integration-test targets and dev-only dependencies, following existing source overrides.
validation: Exact upstream archive/file and local patch/source SHA-256 inventory.
Full lockfile and normal/E2E cross-target graphs must contain no chrono.
Native configuration serialization and a compiler-error fixture reject accidental chrono feature use.

javascript.scope: Application-owned backports of the exact unchanged upstream package identities for development tools only. Registry audits do not certify local file dependencies: provenance, installed-resolution and adversarial regressions plus a separate audit of upstream identities are mandatory. Raw upstream findings remain visible; no advisory ignores or invented patched upstream releases.
javascript.policy: Repeated +(...) and *(...) extglobs are intentionally unsupported in development-tool backports and use the upstream escaped-literal fallback. This removes the reported repeated-extglob attack surface even when recursion limits are disabled. Ordinary wildcard/globstar, brace, dotfile, optional and negative extglob behavior is preserved; consumer compatibility and the exact rejected patterns are tested.

reviewedAdvisory.title: picomatch vulnerable to ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs

javascript.peerDiagnostic: The pinned package manager reports the file-backed optional fdir peer as a non-semver locator. Mandatory consumer checks verify the actual 4.0.7 manifest and exact reviewed source; no peer or advisory ignores are configured.
